# t_funcs.ramp_offon { #clerq.t_funcs.ramp_offon }

```python
t_funcs.ramp_offon(index)
```

Return a ramp-off / ramp-on time function.

The pulse starts at ``ampl``, dips smoothly to zero, then rises back to
``ampl``. Built by composing :func:`ramp_on` and :func:`ramp_off`.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                        | Default    |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| index  | int    | Integer suffix used to look up parameters in args. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                         |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | TFunc  | Callable ``f(t, args)`` reading ``ampl_{index}``, ``fwhm_{index}``, |
|        | TFunc  | ``off_{index}``, and ``on_{index}`` from args.                      |
